title: Anti Alt
description: Protect your server against malicious players!
body:
AntiAlt automatically bans players with flagged usernames known to be stolen or alt accounts, using a remotely updated name list so you never have to manually configure anything.

## Features

- Always up to date remote name list
- Works with LiteBans, LibertyBans, AdvancedBan, and all major banning plugins!
- Exclude trusted players via /antialt exclude
- Reload config and refetch names on the fly with /antialt reload
